Task T035 (Sensitivity Analysis) claims to 're-run null models internally' to avoid dependency on T020/T022. However, T020 and T022 are marked [X] (completed) in Phase 3. This creates a semantic conflict: if T020/T022 are complete, T035 should consume their outputs (or re-run them with new parameters). If T035 re-runs them, T020/T022 are redundant. The ordering implies T035 depends on T018 (US1 core) but the internal logic description contradicts the explicit dependency list which states T035 'does not depend on the completion status of T020/T022'.

Task T047 (Validate tree) is placed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but explicitly states it must run 'immediately after T009 and before T029'. T009 is also in Phase 2. However, T047 is marked [X] (completed) while T009 is also [X]. If T009 failed (as the URL suggests), T047 cannot validate a missing file. The ordering is correct (T009 -> T047 -> T029), but the 'completed' status on broken tasks makes the flow invalid.
